verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs describe agents and automations that run without a user present: scheduled automations for status updates and reports, workflows that fire on real-time data events, and agents built from a plain-language goal and rules that then act on their own. The evidence covers recurring schedules, not just one-off actions, and event-driven triggers. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of background execution behavior (limits, monitoring, failure handling) and independent or hands-on confirmation that these automations run reliably unattended.
